explanation: The value is 0 everywhere except at D2 late in the episode (about trial 85 onward) when the agent chose a1 and reached S2 by a rare transition; a2-to-S1 rare transitions and anything before about trial 85 stay at 0. In those cases it is about 10 if the previous trial was unrewarded, especially if that previous trial was also an a1-to-S2 rare one; it is about 4-6 if the previous trial was rewarded, and 0-1 when the rare trial comes right after two rewarded common trials.
